day_shape: 90 items: Iran-US indirect talks via Qatar intensify in New York with Strait of Hormuz central, US aviation sanctions ground Iraqi/Omani routes to Iran, OFAC publishes GLs Y and Z, heavy Khamenei school-reopening message cycle.

threads.label: Iran-US indirect talks in New York
threads.summary: Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Bagheri confirmed contacts with Washington via Qatari mediators conveying Tehran's conditions including end of war, halt to US actions and lifting of the maritime blockade. Trump said Witkoff and Kushner held a three-hour meeting with Iranian mediators and cited 'momentum' toward a deal potentially reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Iranian aviation sanctions bite regionally
threads.summary: OFAC published Iran-related General Licenses Y and Z, and Iraq ordered suspension of Iranian flights to Baghdad from Wednesday after US threats to sanction airports servicing Iranian carriers. Iran cancelled Tehran-Baghdad and Tehran-Muscat routes, while Iranian state media and Bloomberg reported some international Iranian flights continued past the US deadline, including a landing in China.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Qeshm incident
threads.summary: An Iranian parliamentary committee approved provisions authorising seizure of 20% of cargo value from ships breaching Iran's Hormuz passage rules, with vessels detained until penalties are paid. Iran reported an explosion heard at sea near Qeshm Island with no impact, as Hormuz reopening featured in US-Iran contacts.

threads.label: Khamenei school-year message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released a full message marking the reopening of schools and universities, followed by at least ten excerpt posts on teachers, national identity, martyred students and 'power from knowledge' as a shield against the US and Israel. IRIB and Defa Press carried parallel bell-ringing ceremonies with the acting defence minister and parliament speaker Qalibaf.

threads.label: UNGA diplomacy around Iran and Gaza
threads.summary: Pezeshkian landed in New York for UNGA facing domestic pressure over any Trump meeting, while Macron said 'so-called peace in Gaza' shames all and later walked back reported comments on Hamas West Bank operations as a translation issue. Syrian President al-Sharaa said Israel-Syria talks had reached 'almost 90%' agreement, and Iraqi PM al-Zaidi pledged to disarm Iran-backed militias by June 2027.

threads.label: Gaza operations and reconstruction plan
threads.summary: Netanyahu and Katz announced an Israeli strike in Khan Younis killed Hamas financial chief Mohammed Abu Alwan, and Israeli fire reportedly killed two more in Gaza. The Jerusalem Post reported the Gaza Board of Peace is set to unveil a six-month, $2.45 billion recovery and reconstruction plan.

threads.label: Iran cyber, espionage and executions
threads.summary: Montenegro will extradite Iranian-Turkish hacker Amir Barati to the US over an IRGC-linked cyber campaign, and Iran International reported a hacked Los Angeles freeway sign directed drivers to a site threatening regime opponents. Iran executed IT expert Hossein Pedaran after reported months of solitary confinement and a forced confession, while IRIB claimed rising Israeli recruitment as spies for Iran.

The acting defence minister at the ceremony of ringing the bell for the start of the academic year in one of the schools in Shahid Chamran district emphasised the role of the young generation in building Iran's future and said: Iran's future begins in these classrooms. You are not merely today's student; you are the human and scientific capital of Iran's tomorrow, and Iran needs all the talents of its children for progress.

events.summary_en: When Pérez de Cuéllar declared Saddam an aggressor. On 9 December 1991, the then secretary-general of the United Nations, in an official report to the Security Council implementing paragraph 6 of resolution 598, described the 22 September 1980 attack by the Iraqi army on Iran as an unjustifiable aggression and a clear violation of the UN Charter and formally identified the Ba'athist regime as responsible for and the instigator of the eight-year war. On 9 December 1991, Javier Pérez de Cuéllar, the then secretary-general of the United Nations, in one of the most historic and fateful diplomatic reports of the twentieth century, formally introduced the Iraqi Ba'athist regime to the Security Council as the instigator and aggressor in the eight-year war against the Islamic Republic of Iran.

events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them.
